notes: The contract between Engine and World. Additive changes only — never repurpose a type. Source of truth in code: engine/src/contract.ts (validated on emit and on receive).

envelope.type: one of the event types below

events.engine.boot.started: engine cold boot began · world: dim the lights, begin
events.engine.boot.gate: {connector, ok, detail} · world: gate appears on the globe shell (red if down)
events.engine.killed: kill switch engaged · world: freeze overlay, everything stops
events.engine.snapshot: {snapshot} · world: full redraw on connect (not persisted to the black box)
events.objective.created: {text, env, objectiveId} · world: seed node materializes in territory
events.plan.compiled: {plan} · world: circuit grows node-by-node from seed — the plan IS the shape
events.objective.completed: {deliverables, summary, durationMs, modelCalls} · world: circuit settles & brightens; onetime dissolves
events.objective.failed: {reason} · world: circuit dims with red fracture
events.circuit.paused: world: circuit motion stops, amber tint
events.step.ready: {stepId} · world: node brightens to ready state
events.worker.booted: {workerId, stepId, profile, model, skills[]} · world: red sphere ignites, skill slabs slot in, blue scaffold rays extend
events.model.called: {provider, model, promptChars, attempt} · world: pulse travels into the sphere
events.step.progress: {stepId, summary} · world: edge pulse + inspector summary update
events.validation.passed: {stepId, checks[]} · world: edge flashes green, settles white
events.validation.failed: {stepId, reasons[], attempt} · world: red fracture flash + report thread toward evolver
events.worker.rebooted: {workerId, reason} · world: sphere blinks out, re-ignites grounded (ring-2)
events.step.completed: {stepId, summary} · world: node locks in, settles white
events.step.failed: {stepId, reason} · world: node fractures red, stays broken
events.security.check: {ring, subject, ok} · world: white security sphere pulse on its orbit
events.security.blocked: {ring, subject, reason} · world: hard red flash on the security shell
events.security.gate.waiting: {gateId, tier, action, detail} · world: amber gate node, pulsing, clickable
events.security.gate.approved: {gateId} · world: gate flashes green and dissolves
events.security.gate.denied: {gateId} · world: gate flashes red and dissolves
events.governor.alert: {kind, detail} · world: amber banner — budget/loop watchdog
events.report.filed: {reportId, target, kind, evidence} · world: red thread flows from circuit to the evolver block
events.memory.written: {memoryId, summary, tags[]} · world: crystal node appears
events.memory.decayed: {memoryId} · world: crystal dims out and vanishes
events.memory.promoted: {memoryId, target} · world: crystal ascends into structure
events.evolver.cycle.started: {cycleId, trigger} · world: the green giant wakes
events.evolver.captured: {cycleId, target, reason} · world: capture beam from reports
events.evolver.decomposed: {cycleId, replayCount} · world: target splits into shards
events.evolver.mutated: {cycleId, candidates} · world: candidate clones orbit the giant
events.evolver.trial: {cycleId, candidate, replay, pass} · world: clones compete in the testing hangar
events.evolver.promoted: {cycleId, target, version} · world: green conduit pulse from testing to main
events.evolver.rejected: {cycleId, reason} · world: giant settles, incumbent holds
events.connector.added: {name, status} · world: gate appears on the globe
events.skill.updated: {name, version, by} · world: skill slab glints (green=evolver, white=user)
events.skill.canary: {name, version, baselineFailRate} · world: skill slab pulses amber-green — promoted on probation
events.skill.rolledback: {name, fromVersion, toVersion, reason} · world: red glint — a regression was caught and reverted
events.capability.graduated: {capability, from, to, approvals} · world: gate dissolves into the shell — autonomy earned with receipts
events.worker.escalated: {stepId, from, to} · world: sphere reignites brighter — recovery ladder reached for a stronger model
events.critic.flagged: {stepId, issues[]} · world: brief violet flash — adversarial review fed back before retry
events.step.decomposed: {stepId, into[]} · world: node splits, circuit regrows — a too-big step became smaller steps
events.circuit.scheduled: {circuitId, text, env, everyMinutes, nextRunAt} · world: faint orbit ring marks a recurring circuit

commands.settings.update: {patch} — anthropicApiKey goes straight to the vault, never echoed
commands.circuit.schedule: {text, env, everyMinutes} — register a recurring circuit
commands.gdocs.connect: {} → {authUrl} — begin Google OAuth (loopback); errors if no client credentials configured
